scenicChapters.title: Bangkok / Thailand → Pattaya Coast and Silverlake food stop
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 64 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

bangkok-thailand-pattaya-coast-and-silve.story: 260 km round from Bangkok - plan on about 4 h 44 of riding. The plan has 1 food stop marked.

scenicChapters.title: Montenegro Durmitor Ring
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 71 km this is Montenegro Durmitor Ring, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-grcko-groblje-grebnice.story: 281 km from Prijepolje to Prijepolje, about 4 h 51 of riding. It goes by way of Durmitor National Park, Grebnice and back through Durmitor National Park. The highest point is about 1,550 m. It crosses from Serbia into Montenegro - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
